author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Anthropic sued Clawdbot, forced it to change its name to OpenClaw and ended up letting OpenAI pick up the hottest AI app of 2026

I am not surprised if this turns out to be the biggest blunder that caused the Anthropic losing the AI ecosystem war to OpenAI.

Claude Code is so 2025, just like GitHub Copilot or Cursor is so 2024.   Claw has the vibe in 2026.
